title: Native controls on dot and tube displays
blurb: Six controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt as custom elements with native inputs inside a canvas: a cinema list on an LED board, a paged departures table, a message counter, flip-dot stars, a VCR timer and a teletext command list. The canvas draws each element at one pixel a dot and enlarges it through a mask, with no readback.
question: Can a native control keep its own CSS and behaviour and be shown as an LED board, a flip-dot panel or a tube picture by the canvas that holds it, with no getImageData()?
result: Yes in the test browser. A reduced drawElementImage(), a drawImage() copy and an enlarged draw through a dot mask make the board, and a draw with no alpha puts the hit regions back. The text caret is not in the picture.
